name: BJ Pickard
paragraph_one: BJ Pickard is the executive director and head coach of River Falls Girls Flag Football. Pickard spearheaded Carbonite Sports’ first all-girls flag football division, serves on the Minnesota Vikings’ Advisory Council for Women’s Flag Football, and is a consultant for the Midwest Women's College Flag Football League.
paragraph_two: Pickard played club flag at the University of Wisconsin-Eau Claire, where he minored in coaching before earning his Master’s degree in intercollegiate athletic leadership from the University of Washington. A former pro football executive and college athletics administrator, Pickard also holds coaching certifications from NFL FLAG, USA Football, and the Positive Coaching Alliance.
paragraph_three: As a coach, Pickard’s approach emphasizes core fundamentals, mental performance, honest communication, and a person-first philosophy. Players can expect purposeful practices, meaningful opportunities to compete, and an environment of encouragement and support.
safety: All coaches working directly with athletes will complete club screening and training requirements, which may include background checks, abuse-prevention education, concussion education, and applicable player-safety courses.
mental_performance: Players will learn practical routines to maintain confidence, regain focus, manage pressure, respond to mistakes, and move confidently to the next play.
